snippet.title: LUMINARIA: DARK ECHOES – Official Trailer | Available Now
snippet.description:
⚔️ LUMINARIA: DARK ECHOES – Official Trailer
🌑 A roguelike descent into darkness awaits...

After an amazing Early Access journey, the full version of Luminaria: Dark Echoes launches on June 10.

With the support of Dojo,  we’ve brought this dark and atmospheric roguelike to life. Thank you to everyone who joined us on this path!

🎮 LAST DAYS of Early Access
📅 Release date: June 10, 2025

🟪 Add to your PS5 Wishlist:
https://store.playstation.com/es-es/concept/10013956
🟩 Add to your Steam Wishlist:
